_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.50.0 and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.67.0, a pair that has to move together: beamlynx-ui 0.67.0 needs pine-lang 0.50 (its RequiredVersion) for access policy annotations and refusals that name the hidden column, which agent investigations rely on.
